events.verdict: Holmgren (OKC) legally contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Brooks (PHX) and Holmgren (OKC) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
O'Neale (PHX) contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
O'Neale (PHX) establishes himself in Dort's (OKC) path prior to the contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Booker (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Booker initiates contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Dort (OKC) makes marginal contact with Ighodaro's (PHX) body as he moves over the pick on the perimeter.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Booker (PHX).

Brooks (PHX) is moving alongside Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path as he defends the driving shot attempt. Brooks reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs with Gilgeous-Alexander's side as he gather and begins his upward shooting motion.
Brooks (PHX) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Booker (PHX) makes marginal contact with Caruso's (OKC) body as he defends the driving shot attempt. The marginal contact is compounded by Caruso's own momentum as he attempts to slip the defenders.
Dort (OKC) contests the jump shot attempt by Brooks (PHX) and the contact after his release is marginal.
Holmgren (OKC) makes marginal contact with Ighodaro's (PHX) arm while he pursues the rebound.
Following the rebound, Ighodaro (PHX) reaches for the ball and initiates illegal contact to Holmgren's (OKC) face that is more than marginal.

Wallace (OKC) is moving alongside Gillespie's (PHX) path as he defends the driving shot attempt. Wallace stops short of Gillespie as he enters into his upward shooting motion and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Hayes-Davis (PHX) is moving alongside Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Gillespie (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the drive.
Hayes-Davis (PHX) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).

Williams (PHX) is already in Dort's (OKC) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen. The contact that occurs as both players attempt to disengage from the screen is incidental.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
